title: Five-spoke wheel
prompt: Five-spoke wheel, 100 mm diameter and 10 mm thick, centred on the origin on Z = 0: an 8 mm wide rim (so the opening goes out to R42), a Ø28 hub with an Ø8 axle hole, and five straight 8 mm wide spokes, evenly spaced, from the hub to the rim. Make the number of spokes a parameter called spokes.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Rim, spokes and hub are one solid
One Ø8 axle hole on the axis
Five evenly spaced spokes keep the centroid on the axis

notes: Disc 78539.8 − window π(42² − 14²)·10 = 49260.2, + 5 spokes (the 8 mm band between R14 and R42, 2249.8 mm³ each), − axle π·4²·10 = 502.7. The prompt does not ask for the spokes' angle: a symmetric wheel measures the same at any rotation (bounding box, centroid, volume), so a stated angle could not be tested.
